description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Kiewit is seeking an Integrative Engineering Analyst to support its Integrative Engineering & Technology Solutions team. The role focuses on requirements management, verification and validation, project information coordination, and continuous improvement of Systems Engineering processes.
Systems engineering analyst managing infrastructure requirements, traceability, verification, and validation

Responsibilities:
• Learn, apply, and follow applicable company procedures, project requirements, and Systems Engineering standards, including relevant Kiewit Engineering procedures, INCOSE guidance, and ISO/IEEE 15288 principles
• Review contract, client, standard, code, and regulation documents to identify, interpret, and document technical and non-technical requirements
• Support Requirements Management activities, including requirements capture, definition, allocation, attribute assignment, repository maintenance, and Requirements Verification Traceability Matrix (RVTM) development
• Support Requirements Verification and Validation activities by coordinating discipline input, tracking verification methods, phases, evidence, compliance status, and related review information
• Use project tools, templates, trackers, and SharePoint-based workflows to organize requirements information, maintain current project data, and support reporting or dashboard updates
• Coordinate and communicate with discipline teams, project stakeholders, and supervisors to collect input, clarify requirements, resolve comments, and complete assigned Systems Engineering tasks
• Support continuous improvement of Kiewit Requirements Management and Systems Engineering processes by identifying lessons learned, process gaps, and opportunities to improve templates, workflows, and project execution

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in an Engineering related field
• Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Smartsheet
• Dedication to learn and apply Requirements Management concepts and best practices
• Ability to organize, plan, and execute with logical thinking
• Ability to work independently and coordinate with multiple teams within the company
• Excellent oral and written communication

Preferred:
• Experience with Requirements Management Tools (IBM DOORS, IBM DOORS NG, Helix ALM, Visure, or Jama Connect) – preferred
• Knowledge of Systems Engineering fundamentals including V-model lifecycle – preferred
• Knowledge of Requirements Management practices in accordance with: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148: Systems and software engineering — Life cycle processes — Requirements engineering, ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288: System and Software Engineering – System Lifecycle Processes, and INCOSE •    Systems Engineering Handbook: A Guide for System Life Cycle Processes and Activities – preferred
• INCOSE ASEP Certification - preferred
